title: Tech Note: Adding Window Snapping to 4D
author: Tai BUI, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Classic 4D window commands (SET WINDOW RECT-style positioning)

historical_commentary.text: This note reimplements OS-level window snapping (a native Windows feature since Windows 7) manually inside 4D applications because 4D forms/windows did not natively support it; this is a classic example of a 4D developer working around a platform gap with custom code. The techniques (menu shortcuts, invisible buttons, event-driven palette window) remain functionally valid in classic 4D windows today, though this is a niche UI convenience most developers now skip in favor of relying on the OS's native window management.
related_updates: Native OS window snapping (Windows Snap, macOS window tiling) has become more capable and often makes app-level snapping redundant
The described classic-window techniques still function in current 4D for developers who still want in-app snapping control
